limitations: Empty or failed queries do not establish absence of an incident.
A full log-limit response may be truncated; narrow the time window.
DeepScan findings are returned text, not original Kubernetes Event objects.
RJob finishTime is not an audited stop-request timestamp.
Stopped phase alone does not identify the actor or the initiating cause.
All-operation audit rows may lack changed fields or an initiating reason.
A controller update after SIGTERM is not an initiating stop request.
Audit data is arbitrary; inspect workload-specific secrets before archiving.
